title: Select Primary Architecture Style - Banking
context: The online banking platform requires architectural support for transaction processing during normal daily operation.
decision: Adopt Microservices as the primary architecture style.
rationale: Independent services can scale and deploy separately while improving fault isolation.
trade_offs: Higher operational complexity for greater scalability.

title: Introduce Event-Driven Communication - Healthcare
context: The hospital management platform requires architectural support for appointment processing during normal daily operation.

title: Create Independent Business Service - Ecommerce

title: Select Primary Database Technology - Banking
context: The online banking platform must manage financial transaction data reliably during normal daily operation.
decision: Use PostgreSQL as the primary transactional database.
rationale: Relational integrity and ACID transactions support consistent persistent data.
trade_offs: Strong consistency is prioritised over schema flexibility.

title: Partition High-Volume Records - Healthcare

decision: Partition appointment records using business identifier and time ranges.
rationale: Partitioning supports growth and reduces query scope.

title: Introduce Database Replication - Ecommerce

title: Define Independent Data Ownership - Logistics

rationale: Immutable records improve auditability and accountability.
